digest:
- Selective stabilized its casualty reserves by pricing out weaker commercial accounts, resulting in lower retention. This creates a prime opening for Nirvana's telematics-based underwriting to win better commercial risks as brokers face stricter carrier underwriting [3].
- A market report projects steady growth for shipment tracking platforms driven by AI, IoT, and e-commerce. Wider adoption of advanced tracking enhances fleet visibility, aligning well with Nirvana's telematics-based underwriting models [1].
- Novacore agreed to acquire Diesel Insurance Solutions, expanding its specialty transportation footprint. While focused on cross-border trucking rather than parcel delivery, it highlights active M&A in specialty transportation [4].
